prose_body:
**Finding**: `scripts/local-cleanup.sh` — switching to `git fetch origin main` + `git reset --hard origin/main` may not update `refs/remotes/origin/main` reliably, and also discards any unpushed commits on local main. This is a behavior change unrelated to the larch-log feature.
**Reason not implemented**: Out-of-scope — this local-cleanup.sh change was introduced by Codex as a side change, not part of the larch-log feature plan. Needs separate issue/PR for local-cleanup.sh.
